research_role: causal signal-count and portfolio-efficiency expansion of frozen V64
economic_hypothesis: An underextended stock making its first controlled 20-session pressure break during PIT industry breadth ignition can continue for roughly 15 sessions in either of two mutually exclusive participation states: an established medium-term broad bull state, or an early diffusion state in which 20-session market breadth is already broad but 60-session breadth has not yet recovered. In the early state, excluding explosive industry breadth saturation and requiring an old pressure memory distinguishes price discovery from a short-lived crowded snapback.

source.cooldown: at least 21 market cal_idx between accepted source events for a symbol

source_contract_inherited.industry: industry20 > 3%, industry breadth20 > 60%, industry20 five-session delta >= 3pp, industry breadth20 five-session delta >= 15pp
source_contract_inherited.stock: ret60 in [0%,30%], no prior-20 limit-up, close above frozen prior-20 high
source_contract_inherited.signal: return in [2%,8%], close location >= 70%, turnover ratio in [1.2,4.0]

EARLY_TRANSITION.interpretation: short breadth has diffused, long breadth is not yet established, industry participation is accelerating without complete saturation, and the broken pressure is old rather than a recent local ceiling

mutual_exclusivity: market_breadth60 >=45% versus <45%; one source event can enter only one lane
decision_clock: completed daily signal bar close; all state and pressure fields available no later than decision_at
entry: first legal daily open strictly after signal, within three exchange sessions
time_stop: H15 decision followed by next legal sell open

chronology.post_observation_diagnostic: 2024-01-01 through 2026-09-04; non-pristine and excluded from rule selection

threshold_governance.selection_reason: best development mean among variants with every active development year positive, positive median and date-equal mean, and a stable 90-120 day neighborhood; forward and post-observation outcomes did not select thresholds
